name: application-poll-vote-card
title: Poll / Vote Card
description: Click-to-vote poll card that switches to a percentage-bar results view after voting — percentages and the leading-option highlight are computed from real vote counts, not hand-typed.
useWhen: Running a lightweight single-choice poll where users pick one option and immediately see results.
You want the percentage bars and winning option computed from real vote counts, not designed per-instance.
The poll should transition from an interactive voting state to a read-only results state on submit.
avoidWhen: Users need to change or retract their vote after submitting — this component's local state doesn't model that.
You need multi-select voting (checkboxes, not radios) — extend the state model before reusing this markup.
Results need to be live/real-time across multiple users — wire the vote counts to a real backend and re-render.
responsiveBehavior: The card and its option rows are a single-column block that reflows naturally to any container width.
accessibility: Before voting, options are a real role='radiogroup' of role='radio' buttons; after voting, the group role is dropped since the options are no longer interactive controls.
The leading option after voting is marked with both bar color and bold text, not color alone.
The total vote count is shown as visible text below the results, not implied by bar widths alone.

variants.title: Poll / vote card
variants.description: Four-option framework poll shown in its post-vote results state (Next.js leading at 45% of 150 votes), on a light surface.
accessibility: Percentages are computed with Math.round from real vote counts, so they always sum close to 100%.

variants.title: Poll / vote card (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-option poll results view, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar fill and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
